findings.summary: apply_patch now reaches the guard and delegated edits are blocked.
Patch file directives provide evidence-path detection and a target directory.
The Pi extension resolves scripts from its module location and blocks all guard failures.
Malformed hooks containers and event arrays are rejected.
Regression coverage covers patch edits, Cursor paths, malformed hooks and Codex verification.
Argument prose is emitted outside command backticks.
